intro: Iceflow Lake is a frigid, partially frozen body of water situated in western Dun Morogh, directly north of Brewnall Village. Despite the relentless frost, local dwarves maintain fishing holes through the sheet ice to secure fresh water and fish. The snow-covered islands in the center of the lake are prowled by aggressive winter wolves and their alpha, Timber.

p: Spanning western Dun Morogh just outside Brewnall Village, Iceflow Lake battles the bitter Khaz Modan climate year-round. Thick ice sheets continually creep across the surface, forcing local residents like Paxton Ganter to regularly clear holes for ice fishing and drinking water. While the shore provides sustenance, the islands rising from the middle of the lake are far less welcoming. A fierce pack of wild wolves has made these icy mounds their territory, dominated by the notoriously savage gray worg known as Timber.
